subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Which Android chat message actions should be in scope for the first implementation: Copy only, Copy plus Select Copy, or the full Copy/Select Copy/Share/Reply sheet?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the issue requests multiple UX actions and previous attempts showed reply-context and gesture-interference concerns that need maintainer product direction before automation should build a replacement.

options.title: Copy + Select Copy First
options.body: Implement whole-message copy and a selective-copy dialog now, preserving link tapping and scroll behavior, and leave Share/Reply for a follow-up if product wants them.

options.title: Full Action Sheet
options.body: Implement Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply together, accepting the larger UI and send-context proof burden in one Android change.

options.title: Copy Only
options.body: Add a minimal long-press whole-message copy action and defer selective text selection and other actions to separate issues.

recommendation.title: Copy + Select Copy First
recommendation.body: Implement whole-message copy and a selective-copy dialog now, preserving link tapping and scroll behavior, and leave Share/Reply for a follow-up if product wants them.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently touched and merged Android chat UI work across the active files and merged the adjacent ChatMarkdown link behavior fix.
